title: fix(form): recompute formula fields from the live inputs before judging field rules
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VjQGdf4i6Ff5bzwJcTFarg)_

Fixes #35033

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new member on the `@object-ui/core` package entry (the client formula pass, `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/formulaRecord.ts`), nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单在判 `visibleWhen` / `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` 之前,先用页面上正在输入的值把对象的公式字段算一遍(对象表单渲染器 + 控制台表单视图页 FormPage 两处),`@object-ui/core` 多导出一个 `planObjectFormulas`。
- 为什么改：必填字段的 `visibleWhen` 读公式时,新建表单怎么填都不显示(公式没画在表单上时还会整单拒绝提交),编辑跨过条件也不显示,而服务端按算出来的值要求必填——用户无法保存。
- 风险与回滚：只影响声明了字段规则、且对象有公式字段的表单;算不出的公式(跨引用、`label()`、`current_user` 等)一律按"显示且必填、不拒绝提交"处理,与服务端一致。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/formulaRecord.ts`(`planObjectFormulas` 的可算/不可算分类与读序)、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`(`ruleRecord` 末行与 `fields` memo)、`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`(`ruleValues` 只进规则判定,提交载荷仍是 `values`)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-formula-recompute-35033.test.tsx`,预期 5 passed。
- 需要你做的：无,席位落地(发版冻结期间保持 draft)。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/core`: new `planObjectFormulas(fields)` (exported from the package entry, with its `ObjectFormulaPlan` type). It plans the served object's `formula` fields once and computes them over a record in the platform's read order (`formulaReadOrder`), with the canonical `ExpressionEngine`, as objectql's `formulaValuesFor` does on the server:
  - **A fault a read shares** (an operator over an empty operand, an undeclared key, a cycle, a traversal conflict): the formula reads `null`, and the rule is judged on that `null`.
  - **Unservable**: the formula reads through a reference, calls `label()`, reads a scope root other than `record` (so `current_user.can()` too), is served without its expression (an FLS mask), or reads such a formula at any depth. `unservableReadsOf(pred)` names them.
- Object form renderer (`form.tsx`): reads the object's formulas through `dataSource.getObjectSchema`, by the route `usePatchingUpdateActions` already uses, and only when some field declares a rule (`objectFormulas.ts`). `ruleRecord` = the formulas computed over (null seed, then last-read record, then live values). A field row whose `visibleWhen` reads an unservable formula loses that `visibleWhen`, with one `console.warn`. The field is shown, keeps its `required`, and is no ADR-0137 D2 submit refusal: this is the server's answer for that predicate under ruling record 6956761249 item 3, and the client is never stricter than the server (ADR-0124). The update-action outcome records are recomputed after their patch too.
- Console form-view page (`FormPage.tsx`): the same pass. It was measured as a live create/edit renderer (`/forms/:name`, `?recordId=`, `/f/:slug`) that judges the object-level `visibleWhen` over its own `values`, with the object's fields in hand from `/meta/object`. Only the object-level `rules.visibleWhen` is dropped for an unservable read; the view-level predicate is a layout gate and is left as is. The write payload stays `values`, so a computed formula is never sent.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/formulaRecord-35033.test.ts`: 10 pins on the pass (read order, no mutation, empty operand → null, cycle → null, hop and its closure unservable, `label()` / `current_user` / masked expression unservable, unnameable predicate reads, and the rule verdicts over the computed record).
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-formula-recompute-35033.test.tsx`: 5 pins on the real `form` renderer: create crossing, edit crossing, reverse edit, hop → shown + required + submit allowed once filled, empty operand → judged on `null` with no submit refusal.
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx`: a new top-level `describe` in this harness, holding the same pins for FormPage (create, edit crossing and reverse, hop, empty operand).
- `form-required-for-action-28382.test.tsx` "does not read or note anything on a create form": the create form now makes exactly one object read, and it is the formula pass's, so the assertion is now `toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)`. The note's absence is unchanged.

### Ablation (each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor x1 → x0, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards)

| Leg | Mutation | Red | Green |
|---|---|---|---|
| form M1 | `ruleRecord`: `return formulaPlan ? formulaPlan.compute(out) : out;` → `return out;` | create crossing, edit crossing, reverse edit, empty operand (4/5) | hop (needs M2) |
| form M2 | `fields`: `withoutUnservableVisibleWhen(...)` → `declaredFields` | hop (1/5) | the other 4 |
| FormPage M1 | `ruleValues`: `formulaPlan ? formulaPlan.compute(values) : values` → `values` | create, edit crossing+reverse, empty operand (3/4) | hop (needs M2) |
| FormPage M2 | `sections`: `withoutUnservableRuleVisibleWhen(buildSections(...))` → `buildSections(...)` | hop (1/4) | the other 3 |

The ablations edit sources that the tests import directly (relative imports), so no `dist/` is involved.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measured on `origin/main` 526282e1 with the real renderer (throwaway tests, not committed): create with the formula drawn on the form → the required field stays hidden after crossing; create with the formula not drawn → the rule faults on the missing key, the field shows, and every submit is refused ("Can't submit: the visibleWhen rule of Discount note could not be evaluated."); edit crossing → stays hidden.
- The client's unservable set is the server's plus the roots the form does not bind for a formula (`current_user`, `os`, `previous`, …). Such a formula is shown, never hidden, so the form cannot be stricter than the server.
- `today()` / `now()` formulas are computed with the browser clock and no timezone; the server uses the request's execution context. Near a day boundary the two can disagree. This is noted, not changed.
- On the server, field `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` are judged over the merged record without computing formulas (`formulaValues` feeds only the required-when-shown `visibleWhen` on PR #34978's head). This was read, not reproduced.

## Verification

- form renderer pins: Tests 5 passed (5)

- every ui test that counts `getObjectSchema` reads (40 files): Test Files 40 passed (40), Tests 486 passed (486)
- `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/components` type-check: exit 0. The console type-check needs the whole console closure built, so it is declared to CI (Type Check UI)
